page.overview:
Who is Ito Family?

The Ito Family is a Japanese-Korean family residing in [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Los_Angeles Los Angeles], [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/California California]. Mr. and Mrs. Ito are the parents of G.I. Joe member MacArthur "Quick Kick" Ito. They own and operate a convenience store in the Los Angeles area.
